classes.B: linguistic judgment — replace (AL6a–AL6e, one batch each)

sites.decides: whether a user turn states a durable fact and which clauses are admitted to memory (FACT_MARKERS, health/dietary markers, QUESTION_SHAPE)
sites.deferredReason: Semantic path = classifier statesDurableFacts (already one per-turn call), but extractFactsFromTurn is synchronous, also runs on the Python-twin-free harness bootstrap and on non-classified paths (resume, trivial turns); making it consume the classifier output changes its signature and the trivial-turn (T0) path would need a new call (~1 extra call/turn on T0).
sites.deferredCost: ~1 LLM call per T0 turn if replaced without the classifier; 0 only after AL10 wires TurnSignals into the T0 path

sites.decides: identity vs preference tier of an extracted fact (IDENTITY_TIER_PATTERN, PREFERENCE_TIER_PATTERN)
sites.deferredReason: Tier (identity vs preference) is decided per extracted fact text after extraction; a semantic replacement is a field on StatedFact from the classifier, which only exists on classified turns; lexical fallback would remain for the rest, so no site is actually removed.
sites.deferredCost: 0 calls if folded into statesDurableFacts schema (needs a schema addition + AL5b-certified accuracy, which does not exist yet)

sites.decides: whether a statement is coding-fact-shaped, which gates the always-on contradiction check and fact admission
sites.deferredReason: Zero-LLM pre-filter that exists precisely to avoid a per-belief LLM call in the always-on contradiction check; the plan's event-condition replacement (belief-set change) needs the AL10 layer policy, and removing it now would add a call per belief per turn (AL-7) or weaken the check.
sites.deferredCost: +1 LLM call per non-coding belief per turn if the gate is simply dropped

sites.decides: whether two beliefs oppose each other (negation pairs, polarity words, stopwords)
sites.deferredReason: Pairwise belief opposition is O(n^2) string work run inside the harness detect-contradictions node with a Python twin (contradiction.py) under conformance tests; a semantic replacement is a per-pair (or per-turn batched) LLM call, violating AL-7, and the LLM contradiction checker already exists as the semantic layer.
sites.deferredCost: +1 batched LLM call per turn (or O(n^2) per-pair calls)

sites.decides: abstraction-level contradiction: statement-level keyword match (LINE_LEVEL_KEYWORDS)
sites.deferredReason: Same node and Python twin as negation-opposition; replacing keyword granularity detection needs an LLM classification of each belief's abstraction level.

sites.decides: statement- vs function-level granularity counts feeding abstraction diagnostics
sites.deferredReason: Feeds diagnostics counters every iteration; a semantic count needs per-belief LLM classification (or a signal on belief creation, which AL5a does not provide).
sites.deferredCost: +1 batched LLM call per turn, or a belief-creation-time field (schema change to both twins)
